# Publications 

## World Energy Transition Outlook 2026: 1.5°C Pathway 

IRENA’s revised 1.5°C Scenario, set out in the 2026 edition of the World Energy Transition Outlook, positions electrification, energy efficiency, grids, storage and flexibility as the key drivers of a successful global transition, enabled by renewable energy, clean hydrogen and sustainable biomass.

## Transitioning away from fossil fuels: A roadmap based on renewables, electrification and grid enhancement 

This report provides data and analysis to support the COP30 Presidency’s Roadmap for Transitioning Away From Fossil Fuels (TAFF) initiative, offering a roadmap based on renewables, electrification, energy efficiency, grids and sustainable fuels.
